label: 创建离线云账号
js: (async()=>{const r=await window.maxlabel.cloud.register('', 'parity-c79-'+Date.now()+'@example.com', 'parity-pass'); if(r.ok&&r.data){await window.maxlabel.cloudCredentials.save('',r.data.token,r.data.email); return true} return false})()

label: 填写云模板元数据
js: (()=>{const set=(id,v)=>{const e=document.querySelector('[data-testid='+id+']'); if(!e)return false; const p=e instanceof HTMLSelectElement?HTMLSelectElement.prototype:e instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement?HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype:HTMLInputElement.prototype; Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(p,'value').set.call(e,v); e.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return true}; return set('cloud-template-name','C79-C80-证据模板')&&set('cloud-template-category','物流')&&set('cloud-template-keywords','条码,物流')&&set('cloud-template-description','云模板元数据字段')})()
